entry.name: IBM AI Engineering Professional Certificate
entry.note: A multi-course professional certificate, not a proctored exam; machine learning and deep learning with Python
entry.audience: Career changers and developers moving into machine learning engineering

covers: machine learning algorithms: classification, regression, clustering, dimensionality reduction
supervised and unsupervised learning with SciPy and ScikitLearn
deep learning and neural networks with Keras, PyTorch, TensorFlow
large language models and generative AI architectures
natural language processing and text analytics
computer vision, image and video processing, object recognition
deploying machine learning pipelines on Apache Spark
reading.format: A 13-course series delivered online with hands-on labs, projects, and practical evaluations. Learners build portfolio-worthy projects.
reading.summary: This professional certificate is a 13-course series from IBM on Coursera. It teaches how to build, train, and deploy machine learning, deep learning, and large language models using Python and frameworks such as Keras, PyTorch, and TensorFlow. Learners complete hands-on labs and projects to gain practical experience. Earning the certificate demonstrates job-ready AI engineering skills and provides a career credential.
reading.audience: Data scientists, machine learning engineers, software engineers, and other technical specialists who want to become job-ready as AI engineers. The program is intermediate level.
